salmanshh_simplevisioncast.name: Simple Vision Cast
salmanshh_simplevisioncast.description: Mesh-driven line of sight and dynamic lighting for world objects.

range.name: Range
range.desc: Maximum ray distance in pixels. Larger range = more expensive raycasting. Towers 500px, torches 250px, guards' eyes 300px. Adjust per use case and frame budget.

cone.name: Cone
cone.desc: Angular sweep in degrees. 360 = omnidirectional light. 90 = narrow cone (stealth guards, headlights). Smaller cones are faster to render.

rayDensity.name: Ray density
rayDensity.desc: Percentage of ray density. 100% = 1 ray per degree of cone angle. Higher density = smoother polygon but slower. 25% for many lights, 50% for balanced quality, 100% for precision lighting.

obstacleMode.name: Obstacle mode
obstacleMode.desc: How obstacles are identified. Solid: all objects with the Solid behavior block rays. Custom objects: only selected types block rays. Tag: only instances with a tag block rays. Use Tag mode for flexible, performant obstacle selection.

obstacleTag.name: Obstacle tag
obstacleTag.desc: In tag mode, only instances tagged with this name block rays. Use for walls, terrain, and static obstacles. Add more tags dynamically via AddObstacleTag action.

meshDeformEnabled.name: Mesh deform enabled
meshDeformEnabled.desc: Write the visibility polygon to the host object's mesh for visual rendering each tick. Disable if the light is invisible or for performance (detection still works). Re-enable with EnableMeshDeform action.

meshUpdateInterval.name: Mesh update interval
meshUpdateInterval.desc: How many frames to skip between mesh writes. 0 = every frame, 1 = skip 1 frame, 2 = skip 2 frames.

meshStaggerMode.name: Mesh stagger mode
meshStaggerMode.desc: Stable keeps LOS polygon fixed between stagger ticks. Hybrid updates LOS every frame but only writes mesh on stagger ticks.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the behavior is active. When disabled, raycasting and mesh updates are paused. Toggle at runtime with the Set enabled action.

DisableMeshDeform.description: Stop deforming the host mesh until re-enabled.

EnableMeshDeform.description: Resume writing the visibility polygon to the host mesh.

ResetMesh.description: Restore the mesh to a flat state and disable deformation.

SetMeshPinOrigin.description: Move the mesh fan origin in normalized host space.

SetMaxObstacleCandidates.description: Cap the number of obstacle instances tested each rebuild. Candidates are the first N collected by the active obstacle mode. 0 means unlimited. Reduces raycasting cost in dense scenes at the cost of accuracy.

count.name: Max candidates
count.desc: Maximum obstacles to consider (0 = no limit)

SetMeshStaggerMode.description: Switch the mesh stagger strategy. 'Stable' writes the mesh only on the scheduled interval frame. 'Hybrid' also writes whenever the vision polygon refreshes mid-interval.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Stagger strategy. 'Stable' = mesh updates only on scheduled interval frames. 'Hybrid' = also update when vision polygon refreshes mid-interval.

SetMeshUpdateInterval.display-text: Set mesh update interval to {0} frame(s)
SetMeshUpdateInterval.description: Set how many frames to skip between mesh writes. 0 = every frame, 1 = skip 1 frame, 2 = skip 2 frames.

interval.name: Interval
interval.desc: Frames to skip between mesh writes (0 = every frame)

SetMeshUpdateIntervalTime.display-text: Set mesh update interval to {0} second(s)
SetMeshUpdateIntervalTime.description: Set a time-based interval (in seconds) between mesh writes. Overrides the frame-based interval while active. Set to 0 to revert to frame-based mode.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.desc: Seconds between mesh writes. 0 = revert to frame-based mode.

SetRaycastSkipRate.description: Rebuild the visibility polygon only once every N frames, regardless of stagger mode. 0 or 1 disables skipping (existing stagger rules apply). 2+ skips N−1 frames between rebuilds. Useful for background or off-screen emitters.

rate.name: Rate
rate.desc: Frames per vision rebuild (0 or 1 = no skip, 2+ = skip N-1 frames)

AddObstacleObject.description: Register an object type for custom object obstacle mode.

objectType.name: Object
objectType.desc: Object type to treat as an obstacle.

AddObstacleTag.description: Add obstacle tags in tag mode. Use commas to add multiple tags.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag or comma-separated tags to add.

ClearObstacleObjects.description: Remove every registered custom obstacle object type.

RemoveObstacleObject.description: Unregister an object type from custom object obstacle mode.

RemoveObstacleTag.description: Remove obstacle tags from the active obstacle tag set. Use commas to remove multiple tags.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag or comma-separated tags to remove.

SetConeOfView.display-text: Set cone of view to {0} degrees
SetConeOfView.description: The angle range in degrees relative to the object angle that line-of-sight can cover.

SetFacingAngle.description: Set the cone angle offset relative to the host object.

SetObstacleMode.description: Switch how obstacle candidates are collected.

SetObstacleTag.description: Set active obstacle tags in tag mode. Use commas to provide multiple tags.

SetRange.description: The maximum distance in pixels that line-of-sight can cover.

SetRayCount.description: Set the number of primary rays cast each update.

SetRayDensity.description: Set the ray density as a percentage (1-100). 100% = 1 ray per degree of cone angle. Recalculates on next tick.

SetEnabled.description: Enable or disable the Simple Vision Cast behavior. When disabled, raycasting and mesh updates are paused.

OnRaycastBudgetExceeded.display-text: On raycast took longer than {0} ms
OnRaycastBudgetExceeded.description: Triggered after every vision rebuild in which the raycast took longer than the given threshold. Use LastRaycastMs to read the exact duration. Pair with SetRayDensity or SetRaycastSkipRate to reduce cost adaptively.

budgetMs.name: Budget (ms)
budgetMs.desc: Threshold in milliseconds. Fires when the last raycast exceeded this value.

HasObstacleObject.description: Check whether an object type is registered as a custom obstacle.

HasObstacleTag.description: Check whether a tag is in the active obstacle tag set.

IsEnabled.description: True when the Simple Vision Cast behavior is currently enabled.

IsMeshDeformEnabled.description: True when polygon data is currently written to the host mesh.

IsObstacleModeActive.description: Check whether a given obstacle mode is currently active.

OnObstacleModeChanged.description: Triggered after the active obstacle mode changes.

OnObstacleTagChanged.description: Triggered after the primary obstacle tag changes in tag mode.

IsPointInVisibility.description: Check whether a world-space point is inside the current visibility polygon.

OnMeshNotReady.description: Triggered when mesh deformation is enabled but no writable mesh is found.

OnPolygonUpdated.description: Triggered after the visibility polygon is recomputed.

ActiveMeshStaggerMode.description: Current mesh stagger mode key: "stable" or "hybrid".

ActiveMeshUpdateInterval.description: Current number of frames skipped between mesh writes (0 = every frame).

ActiveMeshUpdateIntervalTime.description: Current time-based mesh write interval in seconds. Returns 0 when frame-based mode is active.

ActiveRaycastSkipRate.description: Current raycast skip rate — frames between vision rebuilds (0 or 1 = no skip).

LastRaycastMs.description: Time in milliseconds spent rebuilding the visibility polygon on the most recent update. Use with On raycast budget exceeded or poll each tick to drive adaptive quality.

ObstacleCandidateCount.description: Number of obstacle instances that were considered in the most recent vision rebuild. Reflects any active candidate cap.

ActiveConeOfView.description: The angle range in degrees relative to the object angle that line-of-sight can cover.

ActiveFacingAngle.description: Current facing angle offset in degrees.

ActiveObstacleTag.description: Current primary obstacle tag, or an empty string outside tag mode.

ARange.description: The maximum distance in pixels that line-of-sight can cover.

CountObstacleObjects.description: Number of registered custom obstacle object types.

CountPolyPoints.description: Number of points in the current visibility polygon.

GetPolyHitUID.description: UID hit by a visibility polygon point, or -1 if unobstructed.

GetPolyPointAngle.description: Angle in degrees of a visibility polygon point.

GetPolyPointDist.description: Distance from the origin to a visibility polygon point.

GetPolyPointX.description: World X of a visibility polygon point.

GetPolyPointY.description: World Y of a visibility polygon point.

LastPolygonUpdateTime.description: Runtime timestamp of the most recent polygon update.

PolygonArea.description: Approximate area of the current visibility polygon.
